extract: crawl mode follows linked pages

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(kind: 'uri', uri: 'https://example.com'), { 'url' => { 'crawl' => { 'max_depth' => 1, 'max_pages' => 4, 'respect_robots_txt' => false }, 'mode' => 'crawl' } })
puts result.summary.pages_crawled.inspect
puts result.results[1].content.inspect
```
